# Corporate Bingo

> Corporate Bingo is software for running 75-ball Bingo for a company or team. The organizer shares one link; guests play on their own phone with just a name, with no app to download. Players never pay. The organizer gives the prizes; we provide the software only.

Site: https://bingo.corporatetambola.com/ . Language: English. Seller: IT Services by Rajat Agarwal (India). Contact: hello@corporatetambola.com .

## What it is
Virtual bingo for remote teams works because everyone plays the same game at the same time, from anywhere. With Corporate Bingo the organizer shares one link. Each guest opens it on their own phone, types a name and gets a Bingo card. There is no app to download and no sign-up for players.

## How a virtual bingo game runs
1. The organizer builds the game and picks the time, the size and the prize patterns.
2. Share one link in Slack, Teams, Zoom chat, e-mail or WhatsApp.
3. Guests open the link, type a name and get a 5 by 5 card with a FREE centre square.
4. Each number is shown and spoken out loud, like G 52, every 6, 9, 12 or 15 seconds.
5. The software finds the winners. You hand over the prizes, and a report arrives by e-mail.

## Made for teams in different places
- Remote and hybrid teams, in any country, on their own phones.
- A call board and a big-screen page work for a projector or a shared video call.
- Prize patterns such as Line, Four Corners, X, Frame or Blackout.

## Questions and answers
Q: How do I set up a game?
A: Use the free AI assistant (the easiest way): tell it what you want and your draft is ready in minutes. Or set it up yourself in the organizer console. Building and publishing are free.

Q: Do players pay or install anything?
A: No. Players never pay and there is no app to download. They open your link, type their name and get a Bingo card. A mobile number is asked only if the organizer chose that.

Q: Who gives the prizes?
A: You, the organizer. Corporate Bingo is software only. We never hold or pay prize money.

Q: Who decides the winners?
A: The software only. Phones work out winners from the public numbers, and a win counts only when enough different phones agree. No person, including the organizer and us, can choose, change or remove a winner. Cheating is very hard.

Q: How is the organizer verified?
A: Through the link or the 6-digit code we send to your e-mail. There is no password to remember.

Q: Can people in other countries play?
A: Yes. Anyone with the link can play on their own phone, in any country.

Q: How do we play bingo online with colleagues?
A: Share one link. Everyone opens it on their own phone, types a name and gets a card. It works next to a video call or on its own.

Q: How many players can join?
A: One game takes up to 100, 250, 500, 750, 1,000, 2,500, 5,000 or 10,000 players, depending on the pack you choose.

Q: Do players pay?
A: No. Players never pay. The organizer gives the prizes.

Q: Does it need an app or a sign-up?
A: No app to download. Players only type a name. The organizer signs in with an e-mail.

Q: What happens to guest details?
A: Guest names, and mobile numbers if the organizer asked for them, are erased within 24 hours after the game ends.

## Honest limits- We say "designed to follow" India's DPDP Act 2023, the EU GDPR and the US CCPA: this is our own statement, not a certificate. We hold no outside certification such as ISO 27001 or SOC 2.
- We say cheating is very hard, not impossible.
- Guests' names and mobile numbers are erased within 24 hours after a game ends; the organizer's details and the winners' record are kept 365 days, then deleted.
